capabilities: Render every *Address object property as a labelled clickable map link
Link partial addresses where street, city or country are optional
Display links to place notes using the note's title or name property
Switch map provider between Google Maps and OpenStreetMap
Rebuild links from current properties on each render so nothing is stored
extras: Documentation is an interactive demo vault shipped with each release and viewable on GitHub; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README compares itself against several geo plugins (Corduroy, Geo Capture, Geocode Note, Geocoding Properties, Map Note, Map View, Maps) as different or complementary steps, and notes the Properties panel cannot edit object values, suggesting Source mode or the Nested Properties plugin.
problem: Addresses in notes are just text, and plugins that store a map link in the note leave a stale link as soon as the address changes.
summary: Property renderer that shows each address property in a note as a clickable Google Maps or OpenStreetMap link, built live without writing anything into the note.
